# braintrust_function (Data Source)

Use this data source to get information about an existing Braintrust function. Look up by `id` or by `name` + `project_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "braintrust_function" "existing" {
  project_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" # replace with your project UUID
  name       = "Pass scorer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the function (UUID). Provide either `id` or `name` (with `project_id`).
- `name` (String) Display name of the function.
- `project_id` (String) The project the function belongs to. Required when looking up by `name`.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of function creation.
- `description` (String) Textual description of the function.
- `function_data_json` (String) JSON object describing the function implementation.
- `function_schema_json` (String) JSON schema for function parameters and return value, or null.
- `function_type` (String) Function type, for example scorer, preprocessor, tool, task, or llm.
- `metadata_json` (String) Function metadata as JSON.
- `org_id` (String) Unique identifier for the organization.
- `prompt_data_json` (String) JSON prompt configuration for LLM-backed functions, or null.
- `slug` (String) Unique identifier for the function within the project.
- `tags` (List of String) Function tags.
- `xact_id` (String) Transaction ID of the function version.
